[[Nippsy's Precision Rifle]] | previous = [[Into The Hornet's Nest]] }} == Objectives == Stop the Shadow Council in the Stormwrought Ruins. * [[Ighal'for]] slain * [[Mergothid]] slain == Description == The Shadow Council. It seems Doomhammer's lap dogs were sloppy. If you are unfamiliar with them, the Shadow Council are - or rather were - Gul'dan's fanatical followers. A cabal of heretics and sinners, devoting their very being to their demon overlords. They were said to have been eradicated following their master's death during the Second War, yet their depravity still prevails. If this missive can be trusted, then the Stormreaver are led by a high ranking and powerful warlock of the Shadow Council, operating from within Stormwrought Castle. , there is little time for respite. Gather an elite force and storm the fallen castle. We need to put a stop to their leader from summoning that demon from beyond the Nether and rescue the remaining citizens still in their clutches. Do not take this lightly, prepare for any eventuality! ==Rewards== You may choose one of: * [[Rufus' Trusty Tankard]] * [[Kinrial's Scalpel]] * [[Noppsy's Compendium]] * [[Nippsy's Precision Rifle]] You will also receive: * 3600 XP == Progress == It may be too much to ask from you, but we don't have any luxuries left at this point. == Completion == What travesties have transpired at this place...? Never have I witnessed such horrors in my life, the thought of such profanities even existing send shivers down my spine. , your bravery in descending this spiral of madness is a heroic feat rarely seen nowadays. Your service to the kingdom and all of the Alliance this day will be remembered by those present and cherished by those affected. These rewards do not match the magnitude of your deeds, but take them nevertheless. You are dismissed. ==Progression== {{Into The Tortured Past}} ==Patch changes== * {{Patch|1.18.0|note=Added.}}
